description: Cross-domain runtime state model, not executable Swift or proof of iPhone behavior.

machines.name: Build and artifact publication
machines.representation: GitHub job/step state
machines.persistence: Actions run, artifact and rolling tag
machines.invariant: An IPA is available only after compile, package, exact-SHA verification and upload.

machines.name: Containing app lifecycle
machines.representation: scenePhase plus startup resets and root view flags
machines.invariant: Reappearing a view must not reset an active operation's authoritative state.

machines.name: Keyboard lifecycle and render readiness
machines.representation: initialStateReady, hostingController, appearance/recovery revisions
machines.invariant: A probe for an intentional stroke/emoji/prompt surface must not remount missing alphabet rows.

machines.name: Typing availability and fallback
machines.representation: derived BasicTypingFallbackReason and effectiveTypingKind
machines.persistence: settings mirrors plus local Full Access
machines.invariant: Ordinary typing remains available independently of voice prerequisites.

machines.name: Shared audio session
machines.representation: isSessionActive, engine, tap and inactivity timer
machines.invariant: Only the audio-session owner mutates actual session lifecycle; capture release and engine lifetime are distinct.

machines.name: Microphone capture lease
machines.representation: UnifiedCaptureOwner? enum
machines.invariant: At most one capture owner; a caller may release only its own capture.

machines.name: Warm and cold dictation handoff
machines.representation: session token, recent heartbeat, retry timer and acknowledgement
machines.invariant: Every acknowledgement/retry/fallback must belong to the same pending request.

machines.name: Microphone tap and hold intent
machines.representation: MicrophonePressPolicy plus local flags and token-scoped hold-stop intent
machines.invariant: One accepted gesture produces one start and one corresponding stop/cancel.

machines.name: Dictation execution and finalization
machines.representation: isRecording/isStopping + session token + outcome
machines.invariant: A terminal path releases only resources belonging to its request and cannot leave isStopping latched.

machines.name: ASR model and native worker lifecycle
machines.representation: ModelLoadState, selected engine, engine-specific tasks/generations
machines.invariant: Load/decode/unload need a pinned model generation and compatible resource lease.

machines.name: Experimental live ASR worker
machines.representation: Task, read offset, chunk revision and isRecording
machines.invariant: No old worker publishes after cancellation; resource reuse waits for worker exit.

machines.name: Live insertion ownership
machines.representation: document ID, suffix anchor, revision, blocked tokens
machines.invariant: Replace only a verified owned range in the same document; later main changes target-dependent live insertion.

machines.name: Final dictation delivery
machines.representation: singleton text file plus transcriptionReady notification
machines.invariant: Delivery must identify request and destination and remain recoverable until acknowledged.

machines.name: Output target and formatting
machines.representation: live VoiceOutputConfiguration and bounded selection retries
machines.invariant: Source speech survives failure; target/configuration must match the result at delivery.

machines.name: Manual AI request bridge
machines.representation: requestID, pending action, isLLMProcessing, global failure notifications
machines.invariant: Every request receives a correlated accepted/busy/terminal outcome and bounded local recovery.

machines.name: Shared text-model inference
machines.representation: isProcessing + LLMLoadState + native worker
machines.persistence: host process and shared busy mirror
machines.invariant: One canonical inference owner; model unload follows completed/cancelled-and-joined native work.

machines.name: LLM insertion and undo history
machines.representation: request/document IDs, selection contexts, history and index
machines.invariant: Unrelated fields/selections cannot be replaced; history indices and destination ownership remain valid.

machines.name: Conversation capture and live preview
machines.representation: recordingSide, activeID, capture options, warmup/live/limit tasks
machines.invariant: Only one side captures; output options are pinned to the turn and native decode is not duplicated.

machines.name: Conversation turn processing
machines.representation: processing flag; ConversationTurn.status String
machines.invariant: A failed stage preserves original audio/source and identifies exactly which stage can retry.

machines.name: Conversation draft durability
machines.representation: turn list, draft folder, persist/restore/save/discard
machines.invariant: Every captured audio file is discoverable after restart, including a crash before a turn is appended.

machines.name: Meeting capture, audio parts and backlog
machines.representation: isRecording, current record, recorder, accumulator and decode task
machines.persistence: meeting manifest and rotating CAF parts
machines.invariant: One tap, bounded FIFO, saved audio parts, and explicit partial-transcript reporting.

machines.name: Meeting finalization and restart recovery
machines.representation: isFinalizing; MeetingRecord.state String
machines.invariant: Relaunch turns abandoned active states into a recoverable inactive state without discarding files.

machines.name: Resumable meeting translation
machines.representation: translatingRecordID, Task, fingerprint/configuration/chunk cursor
machines.persistence: draft and last confirmed output in manifest
machines.invariant: Source/fingerprint/configuration match on resume; previous confirmed output survives partial replacement.

machines.name: Background download registry and installer
machines.representation: URLSession task IDs, metadata dictionaries and processing queue
machines.invariant: Every completion and install commit belongs to the active download generation.

machines.name: Speech model download and readiness
machines.representation: ModelDownloadState plus enqueue tasks and persisted in-progress set
machines.persistence: disk model, preferences and UI state
machines.invariant: Downloaded files, loadability and current residency are distinct facts; a load failure is not proof of corruption.

machines.name: Text model download and upgrade
machines.representation: per-variant ModelDownloadState and upgrade selection flags
machines.invariant: Automatic upgrade respects explicit selection and never invalidates a model in use.

machines.name: Model selection and deletion
machines.representation: selected variant mirrors, file availability and ad hoc busy guards
machines.invariant: A pending operation pins its engine/model; select/delete honor capture, finalization and inference leases.

machines.name: Keyboard surface and input method
machines.representation: page enum + showsEmojiPage + ChineseInputMode preference
machines.invariant: Visible surface has one render owner; persisted stroke is intentional and distinct from missing rows.

machines.name: Cantonese phonetic composition and prediction
machines.representation: JyutpingComposition, candidate spelling and prediction anchors
machines.invariant: A candidate can replace only the document-bound spelling that produced it.

machines.name: Cangjie, Quick and stroke composition
machines.representation: shape/Latin buffers, candidates and host string anchor
machines.invariant: Empty/nil or equal text context is not sufficient proof of the same host document.

machines.name: Latin suggestions and swipe replacement
machines.representation: active word, delayed lookup tasks, alternatives and next words
machines.invariant: Delayed lookups and replacements require a matching document epoch and input revision.

machines.name: Physical letter touch and swipe session
machines.representation: UIKit touch owner, touch state, hold task and LatinSwipeSession
machines.invariant: One physical gesture inserts once; SwiftUI accessibility remains a separate activation route.

machines.name: Cursor and spacebar trackpad
machines.representation: press time, activation task, isTrackpadActive, offset counters
machines.persistence: view-local gesture plus controller cursor preference
machines.invariant: Space insertion and trackpad movement are mutually exclusive outcomes.

machines.name: Repeat delete, symbol hold and Emoji variants
machines.representation: view flags/tasks; related RepeatDeleteButton and EmojiKeyboardView controls
machines.invariant: Cancelled/remounted controls cannot continue a repeat task or emit an unintended base symbol.

machines.name: Shift, caps lock and microphone animation
machines.representation: multiple presentation flags; keyboard shiftActive/capsLock
machines.invariant: Presentation follows operation state; interrupted animations cannot decide business state.

machines.name: Permissions, keyboard probes and onboarding
machines.representation: permission enum, reported probes, OnboardingStep/record/route history
machines.invariant: A cached permission/probe or completed onboarding is not proof that the keyboard is currently selected.

machines.name: Tabs, navigation, sheets and app language
machines.representation: tab enum, four NavigationPaths, banner/sheet state; root language remount
machines.invariant: Navigation/view lifetime cannot erase an operation still owned by a retained coordinator.

machines.name: Voice history and retention
machines.representation: read-modify-write JSON, audio records and retention policy
machines.invariant: Manifest and audio changes remain consistent; failure does not silently report success.

machines.name: Audio playback and tutorials
machines.representation: separate player states; AudioPlayerService and PiPTutorialService
machines.invariant: Playback and capture share AVAudioSession configuration ownership.

machines.name: Settings, prompts, corrections and learned choices
machines.representation: UserDefaults values, local editor copies and custom prompt sheet enum
machines.persistence: App Group preferences and aggregate learning
machines.invariant: Settings change becomes one validated command; deleted prompt/action references are reconciled.

machines.name: Data export, deletion and cache cleanup
machines.representation: category enum, busy flag, detached exporter and share URL
machines.persistence: local data and temporary export archive
machines.invariant: Destructive actions and snapshots respect every active data owner; All Data coverage is explicit.

machines.name: Diagnostic collection and export
machines.representation: bounded JSONL, lock/queue, export/reset state
machines.persistence: App Group log and explicit export file
machines.invariant: Metadata stays bounded and content-free; event lineage can distinguish overlapping operations.

machines.name: Entitlement and free-word allowance
machines.representation: EntitlementStatus and conditional APPSTORE policy
machines.invariant: Development Release behavior is not evidence for AppStore entitlement paths.

machines.name: Host resolution and return
machines.representation: host process/bundle hints, lastHostReturnToken, pending deep links
machines.persistence: remembered host preferences and process tasks
machines.invariant: Return intent is tied to the originating request; dispatching an open is not proof of foreground success.

risks.title: Two source-text tests demand opposite live-insertion behavior
risks.repairContract: Use the later main behavior at 670c8dc as the current source contract. Keep behavioral checks for live source visibility, final target output and document ownership. Do not restore contradictory assertions.

risks.title: Final dictation result has no request or destination identity
risks.repairContract: Use a versioned final-result envelope with requestID, destination epoch, resultID and explicit pending/consumed status. Pin the destination at activation. Keep completed text recoverable through existing history/explicit copy when the destination no longer matches; acknowledge consumption by resultID.

risks.title: A dictation cancel can end Conversation's audio session
risks.repairContract: Make cancel a token- and owner-scoped command. Let the audio-session owner end the session only when leases permit it. Acknowledge stale/foreign cancels as ignored metadata events.

risks.title: Capture ownership does not serialize ASR and text-model resource use
risks.repairContract: Extend the existing ownership approach with ASR decode/load leases and text-job reservations. Pin model generations. Queue or explicitly reject incompatible work with an operation-scoped outcome. Await native workers before unloading; preserve microphone ownership independently.

risks.title: Manual AI can remain busy after an ignored request
risks.repairContract: Persist request-scoped accepted/busy/failed/cancelled/completed outcomes. Start a bounded request timer at submission and reconcile on reappearance. Scope all terminal handling to requestID; keep a recoverable retry action for a missing host acknowledgement.

risks.title: Extension recovery overwrites host-owned runtime mirrors
risks.repairContract: Have the extension request cancellation/reconciliation and update its local projection. Keep canonical runtime writes in host owners. Publish one versioned snapshot with process epoch, revision and operation phase, separating capture from finalization.

risks.title: A cancelled download installer can finish into a replacement task
risks.repairContract: Carry a unique download generation through transfer, verification, staging and commit. Recheck exact generation under the registry lock before installation and metadata mutation. Install into a generation-specific staging directory, then atomically promote only the active generation.

risks.title: SenseVoice's joined load reads the generation after awaiting
risks.repairContract: Capture the joined task's generation before awaiting, as waitForLoad and Qwen3 already do. Keep a task/generation pair and optionally model identity together.

risks.title: IME ownership can survive a field change with identical text context
risks.repairContract: Expose a document epoch through KeyboardProxy or KeyboardState. Bind phonetic/shape composition, suggestions and swipe alternatives to it; cancel/reset on epoch change, even when text strings are equal. Nil identity uses conservative non-replacement behavior.

risks.title: Meeting playback can reconfigure the audio session during capture
risks.repairContract: Route playback/capture category changes through BackgroundAudioSession. Decide explicitly whether playback is blocked or uses compatible routing while capture is active; enforce it in the service and UI.

risks.title: Conversation audio can be saved without a discoverable turn manifest
risks.repairContract: Persist a versioned recording-intent entry containing turn ID, safe audio filename and output configuration before capture. Atomically transition it after Stop. On launch reconcile incomplete entries and known orphan audio into an explicit recoverable state; never delete automatically.

risks.title: Conversation recovery rejects files just beyond its own 25-second timer
risks.repairContract: Separate the user-facing duration cap from the bounded recovery read limit. Use bounded streaming chunks or a small documented tolerance; derive both from one policy and retain a strict memory bound.

risks.title: Persisted status strings do not define restart transitions
risks.repairContract: Introduce Codable status enums and a versioned document envelope, preserving legacy string decoding. Reconcile process-owned active statuses to interrupted/retryable on restart using the actual record/audio state.

risks.title: Diagnostics cannot correlate many overlapping operation transitions
risks.repairContract: Extend the existing structured diagnostics with opaque operationID, parentID where needed, owner, from/to state, generation and enumerated reason. Keep it bounded, content-free and export-only. Do not add a parallel logging system or raw text.

risks.title: Speech download readiness conflates valid files with successful native loading
risks.repairContract: Return a typed load failure and retain validated files for transient/busy/cancelled/resource failures. Delete only proven invalid data under the existing policy; show a retryable load state.

risks.title: All Data export/deletion does not cover the Conversation draft
risks.repairContract: Add explicit conversation-draft coverage and service-level active-owner protection, or use precise category labels and clearly expose separate draft export/deletion. Take a consistent snapshot before exporting; never delete active audio.

additionalReviewAreas.name: Native Globe / Emoji picker
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: iOS/UIViewController owns picker and keyboard selection, no custom Emoji UI or duplicate recognizers

additionalReviewAreas.name: Haptic pulse, driver and reset
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: one pulse per physical gesture; reset generation must not invalidate newer engine; per-process lifetime

additionalReviewAreas.name: Live source versus translated output
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: live words and translated final result differ; delivery must match request and original document

additionalReviewAreas.name: Document epoch for IME / swipe / AI
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: matching visible text does not prove identical document; asynchronous replacements check epochs

additionalReviewAreas.name: Host / keyboard notification acknowledgement
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: Darwin notifications are wakeups, not authoritative states; result/consume are request scoped

additionalReviewAreas.name: Permission and Full Access fallback
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: cached permission does not prove current selection; offline typing remains available

additionalReviewAreas.name: Conversation, playback and session interruption
additionalReviewAreas.invariant: AVAudioSession owned centrally; playback/cancel cannot kill foreign capture; preserve unfinished audio

crossDomainInvariants: One canonical state owner per operation; presentation mirrors are projections.
Cancellation and async completion require matching request ID, owner and generation.
Capture and AVAudioSession are independent scoped resources.
ASR workers and text-model work require compatible leases and cancel-and-join.
Result insertion requires original document epoch and matching request; acknowledge consumption.
IME, swipe, cursor and AI must invalidate stale document-bound work.
iOS owns system Globe/Emoji selection; preserve UIKit and accessibility ownership.
Haptics have one pulse per accepted gesture; reset generation is validated.
Conversation/Meeting audio remains recoverable across restarts.
No diagnostic event records typed text, transcripts, audio or credentials.
